dissents.reason: At 36.3x trailing for only 9.0% EPS growth, ETN is by far the draft's most expensive name relative to its earnings growth, and buying it at a 52-week high right after an 8.3% jump on raised guidance pays for the re-rating with no margin of safety.

LLY sits right on the line of a steep channel rising 71% a year, but its weekly MACD histogram is still falling, so the turn-up my entry needs has not come and the pullback could go deeper this week, which is the same test the draft used to drop all five of my names.
